verdict.rationale: Oneleet serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Public API (157 paths) and a separate Auditor API spec at api.oneleet.com. Its docs link these specs directly and note they can be imported into Postman or used to generate clients. The 404 probes only tested docs.oneleet.com paths, a different host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and the spec itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Oneleet serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Public API (157 paths) at the API origin, plus a second document for the Auditor API
The docs link the machine specs and consoles directly ("OpenAPI specifications and interactive references:") and note you can import the spec into Postman or use it to generate an API client
